A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DS-DiT research and contain readable main text, equations, tables, figures and appendices. Relocated experiments and renumbered tables can be reliably matched.

before.justification: V1 reports original super-resolution experiments on four datasets, component ablations, guidance comparisons and computational measurements, including appendix results.

after.justification: V2 retains the original benchmark results, ablations, guidance analyses and computational measurements.

M1.justification: The shared-QKV siamese attention, PLW fusion, rectified-flow objective and strong/weak-reference autoguidance remain unchanged. Renaming Patch-Level Weights to Patch-Level Weighting does not alter the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate SECOND, FUSU and CNAM-CD at ×8/×16, and Real-RefRSSRD under real cross-sensor ×10 super-resolution. CNAM-CD and Real-RefRSSRD move from v1 Appendix B into v2 Sections 4.1–4.2; they are not new coverage.

E2.justification: SECOND/FUSU retain TTSR, DATSR, CoSeR*, Ref-Diff, CreatiLayout* and M3-DiT; CNAM-CD/Real-RefRSSRD retain the same four diffusion comparators. PAG, SEG and ICG guidance comparisons are also unchanged. Creati* merely abbreviates CreatiLayout*.

E3.justification: The matched experiments retain their splits, scales, metrics, training budget and sampling procedure. V2 supplies dataset-specific settings for experiments previously reported in the appendix, without establishing changed experiments. These additional disclosures are assessed under D1.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same component ablations, injection-strategy comparisons, guidance-coefficient sweep, alternative-guidance comparison and qualitative examples. Their relocation and renumbering introduce no new analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run or seed counts, error bars, confidence intervals or statistical significance tests. The revision introduces no uncertainty-reporting procedure.

E6.justification: All seven tables retain their numerical entries: v1 Tables 2, 3 and 4 correspond to v2 Tables 3, 4 and 2. The qualitative result panels are also unchanged. Expanded benchmark discussion describes results already available in v1.

T1.justification: Equations 1–11 retain the same mathematical content, including the objective, attention and fusion operations, guidance formulation and M3-DiT definition. No theorem, proof or formal assumption is added or revised.

C1.justification: The introduction's empirical contribution broadens from superiority on SECOND/FUSU at ×8/×16 to multiple remote-sensing datasets across diverse settings. This incorporates the scope of existing appendix experiments into the headline contribution; the methodological claims remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Section 4.3 replaces the assertion that combined gains exceed the sum of individual gains with the more restrained statement that they exceed either component alone. Section 4.4 also softens explanations attributing injection failures to unreliable feature fusion. Spatial-alignment and manually tuned guidance limitations remain.

D1.justification: V2 explicitly documents 480 × 480 training/input resolution for Real-RefRSSRD, 512 × 512 for CNAM-CD, guidance 1.1 for both, and training per dataset/scale. These clarify previously reported experiments. Conversely, Table 1 drops the explicit full-test-set evaluation statement. Code access, hardware and training budget remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Reference 25 changes from Lu et al.'s MASA-SR to Luo et al.'s STAIR for the spatial/temporal-resolution background. Other reference changes mainly update metadata, including TODSynth's publication details. The principal positioning against prior architectures remains intact.

P1.justification: V2 polishes terminology and prose in the abstract, introduction, methods and conclusion, and integrates former Appendix B into the experimental section. Author affiliation and acknowledgements are also updated. The overall narrative and section organization remain largely intact.

P2.justification: Figure 1 receives terminology corrections, tables receive spacing and sizing adjustments, and the additional-dataset table moves into the main text. Captions and surrounding layout change modestly; the figures and result displays otherwise retain their content.

improvement.justification: V2 makes existing experiments easier to reproduce through dataset-specific resolution and guidance details, and presents the four-dataset evaluation more coherently in Sections 4.1–4.2. These limited gains outweigh the loss of Table 1's explicit full-test-set statement. The method, numerical evidence and validation coverage remain unchanged, so the overall improvement is modest.
